title: SPCX Liftoff Boosts Tech Ahead of TSLA & META Earnings
speaker: Drew Dosik

macro_themes.view: SpaceX's blastoff and strong after-hours reactions (IBM, Meta) are lifting tech, though semis remain in sideways consolidation.
Without a peace resolution before the midterms, escalation risk keeps him bullish on oil.

calls.condition: Breaking the rising trend line (watch 765.32) would lean toward more downside.
calls.reason: S&P closed well above the rising trend line that has propelled the rally after several days testing it; earnings could lift it further.
calls.quote: So, this is actually a very good close for the S&P 500.

calls.condition: A close above 26,786 puts the near-term breakdown behind it; a break of 26,582 means more downside.
calls.reason: Nasdaq pulled itself back above the level it was hanging from; looking for continuation.
calls.quote: Let's see if we can't have a continuation push tomorrow, get a close above 26,786

calls.condition: Two more days of sideways chop would complete a mature bear flag.
calls.reason: Five days of sideways price after a pop is bearish consolidation; next stop is the bottom of the rising channel at 529.26.
calls.quote: if this continues around this range, that's going to be all bearish consolidation.

calls.reason: Yield hit resistance at pivots from June 2007 and has come straight down and chopped sideways; his Sleeper Hold signal called the brakes.
calls.quote: The Sleeper Hold called this whole pattern set up right here, putting on the brakes.

calls.condition: Bear flag breaks if 4,100 support gives way.
calls.reason: Tight consolidation is a bear flag targeting about 3,950, with more downside to trend line support at 3,650 then 3,500, a long-term buy zone.
calls.quote: I'm anticipating more downside for gold

calls.reason: Near-term bull flag inside a larger bear flag; an unhit head-and-shoulders target at 53.26 is where he'll buy SLV, adding physical near 50.
calls.quote: head and shoulders pattern with a target that has not yet been hit, $53.26 still to be hit.

calls.condition: Must hold above 85,000 and base in the 85,000-86,500 range before attacking the 89,900 neckline; clearing it negates the head-and-shoulders.
calls.reason: Up 1.88% and back above consolidation; step-by-step basing could lead to a push through the old H&S neckline.
calls.quote: get yourself back up above 85,000 start consolidating in this upper range 86,500 uh to right around $85,000.

calls.condition: Peace news would pull prices down and negate the inverse head-and-shoulders; no resolution before midterms makes him more bullish.
calls.reason: Stalled at the September 18 pivot as he predicted, but an active inverse head-and-shoulders targets 116 amid Middle East escalation risk.
calls.quote: that all points to a targeted move up here to $116.

calls.reason: Retesting breakout at stacked support after a mild-winter forecast; inventories below the 5-year average, so a bounce is likely.
calls.quote: I'm still bullish even with this move down on nat gas. I see this as a potential buying opportunity coming right into support.

calls.reason: Nearly 50% off May highs into stacked support (trend line, gap fill, pivots) with weekly RSI ~32; expects a relief bounce to about 89.
calls.quote: If we don't see a bounce in this general area, I will be very surprised on the chart of Baidu.

calls.condition: If it opens above 265.83 the next resistance is 281.55; otherwise 265.83 caps it near term.
calls.reason: After-hours earnings breakout above a trend line from the June high, though the pre-report run looked 'fishy'.
calls.quote: Regardless of this situation, we're talking about a breakout at hand on the chart of IBM.

calls.condition: If it opens above 403.78 it has room to 421.88; otherwise it likely pierces and consolidates under the ~400 resistance cluster.
calls.reason: Stacked resistance (declining and rising trend lines, 50% fib) right around 400.
calls.quote: if Tesla manages to gap up over $400, meaning that tomorrow morning at 9:30 in the morning, it opens above 403.78

calls.reason: Breakout-retrace-bounce off the middle of a rising channel with buyers defending the lows for days, then an after-hours earnings pop.
calls.quote: It's like a flashing yellow light right there on the screen saying buy this level and buy it now

calls.condition: If it opens below the 241.60 low pivots, expects a beeline to the 224.35 gap fill; opening above lets it re-attack today's gap.
calls.reason: Dropping hard after earnings after breaking its rising channel and failing the retest.
calls.quote: Should we open up underneath that low pivot tomorrow, I'm anticipating price making a beeline straight down here to this gap fill.

notes: No explicit date stated; Tesla/Meta/IBM/LRCX reported after the bell 'today' and SpaceX reported 'yesterday', which places the recording on Wed Oct 21, 2026 after the close (listing says Oct 22). S&P levels quoted in SPY-style dollars (765.32). Nasdaq levels are the Composite (IXIC), mapped to NQ. SMH kept as its own ticker. TXN mentioned with no view.
